title: Lacatski's books describe UFOs as consciousness puzzles
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Lacatski's books describe UFOs as consciousness puzzles, about 2007-2012 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: if you read his book uh new insights and I think his other book as well he talks about UFOs as puzzles as like almost consciousness puzzles.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that James Lacatski, a US defence intelligence official who ran a government-funded study of UFOs (unidentified flying objects) in roughly 2007 to 2012, wrote books describing UFOs as puzzles. According to Michels, in a book with "New Insights" in its title, and perhaps in another one, Lacatski treats them almost as puzzles about consciousness, the mind itself. If true, it would suggest someone inside that government study saw UFOs as a question of the mind, not just of machines.
